coveredBehaviours: the batch is bound to the verified candidate, product source, migration set and arithmetic backend
at least three increasing player counts are required and must include the declared supported maximum
every candidate-declared pairing system is measured at every required player count
every probe has at least three samples and its repetition denominator must be exact
every sample must succeed within both declared latency and peak-memory budgets
repeated immutable-input samples must have one deterministic functional-output hash
the complete pre-write performance route must record zero writes
missing matrix cells and malformed denominators are infrastructure errors; overruns are honest NO_GO outcomes
GO does not claim the verifier executed or timed the product route
